title: HTML Capsule Writeback Bundle
description: Schema v0.1 for writeback.bundle.json — the export envelope produced by HTML Capsules at L2+ interactivity. Defined in Spec §11 and §17. A writeback bundle collects proposed mutations to external systems (MeatyWiki, CCDash, SkillMeat, IntentTree, Control Plane) for human review and optional application.

schema_version.description: Bundle schema version. Must be exactly '0.1' for this schema release.

capsule_id.description: Stable identifier of the HTML Capsule that produced this bundle. Matches capsule_manifest.html_capsule.capsule_id.

bundle_id.description: Optional stable identifier for this specific writeback bundle (e.g. 'wb_2026_05_09_html_capsules'). Useful for idempotent re-application.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the bundle was generated.

review_status.description: Overall review lifecycle state of the bundle.

source_capsule_version.description: Optional — schema_version of the originating capsule manifest.

writebacks.description: Ordered list of proposed writeback operations. Each entry targets one external system with a specific action and payload.

writeback_entry.description: A single proposed writeback operation targeting one external system.

target.description: The external system this writeback targets.

action.description: The operation to perform on the target system.

status.description: Review lifecycle state for this individual writeback entry. Defaults to 'proposed' if omitted.

destination.description: Optional destination descriptor within the target system — a page path, node ID, event type, artifact type, or routing note depending on the target.

path.description: Resource path or page path within the target system (e.g. 'projects/meatywiki/patterns/html-capsules.md').

node_id.description: Node or entity ID within the target system.

payload.description: The data to be written to the target system. Structure is target-specific; use the per-target payload sub-schemas below as guidance. Free-form object to accommodate all target systems. anyOf is used intentionally: payload sub-schemas are descriptive (no required fields) and a payload may satisfy multiple shapes simultaneously.

notes.description: Human-readable rationale or notes for this writeback entry.

approved_by.description: Identifier of the person or agent that approved this writeback.

applied_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this writeback was applied.

payload_meatywiki.description: Payload for MeatyWiki writeback — a Markdown page create or update.

markdown.description: Markdown content to write to the target page.

frontmatter.description: Optional YAML frontmatter fields to merge into the page.

tags.description: Tags to apply to the MeatyWiki page.

payload_ccdash.description: Payload for CCDash writeback — an execution event or dashboard entry.

event_data.description: Structured event data to record in CCDash.

capsule_ref.description: Reference back to the originating capsule.

payload_skillmeat.description: Payload for SkillMeat writeback — an artifact or SkillBOM candidate.

artifact_spec.description: Artifact specification data to create or update.

collection_path.description: Target collection path for the artifact.

payload_intenttree.description: Payload for IntentTree writeback — a tree node create or update.

node_data.description: Node data to write to the IntentTree.

parent_node_id.description: Parent node ID to attach this node under.

payload_control_plane.description: Payload for Control Plane writeback — a routing decision or policy signal.

routing_note.description: Human-readable routing decision or note for the control plane.

decision_data.description: Structured decision payload for the control plane.
